customfield_10020.name: Sprint 1
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal
Reduce operational risk and improve visibility of Slots

Main deliveries
- Re-enable Save Filters and fix filter persistence and presentation.
- Implement a notification panel for slots without assigned drivers.
- Improvements in Slot Detail: show Slot ID / Coverage ID / Shift ID, fix map fitBounds, and add a legend for driver color states.

Technical support:
We need to be available for any support team tickets, QA cards, and cards that may come from other squads during this transition period.

Sprint Constraints
May 25th is a holiday for the team that is outside of Brazil. 

Risks
No identified risks related to the Slots project. Monitor for possible intrusions from Middle Mile / Control Tower topics.

Validations
Validate the final delivery with Naiara Domingues and the Operations team, and monitor for potential improvements after release.

customfield_10020.name: Sprint 2
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal
- Bringing OTP validation to the app makes pickup/delivery/return safer without disrupting the delivery person's workflow.
Main deliveries
- OTP screen + gating — code entry screen (6 digits, loading/error, i18n es/en/pt), displayed only when the timeline marks the action as active: true.
- Validation before status change — integration with POST /v3/otp/validate; the status only advances in case of success, with error and retry in case of failure.
- Resend with cooldown + "no code" flow — POST /v3/otp/resend with button blocked during cooldown, and alternative path when the client does not have the code.
- Legacy removal + E2E QA — single path (validate → change status), with regression on dropoff and end-to-end QA in beta.

Sprint Constraints -> June 4th will be a holiday in Brazil.
Risks -> No risks foreseen in this sprint.
Validations -> No stakeholder validation occurred during sprint 2.

customfield_10020.name: Sprint 2
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal
- Standardize the dashboard on shared platform components and bring real-time visibility to the Smart Notification driver-rotation process.

Main deliveries
- Real-time visibility of Smart Notifications — propagate data to Firebase (userId, slotId/deliverySlotId, round), extend the RealTimeProgress widget to the smart notification collection, display jobs in the Slots header, and redesign the card in Route Detail.
- Standardization of Slots in shared components — replace proprietary implementations with platform standards: RealTimeProgress instead of  JobsBadge, Dialogs.GenerateReport instead of SlotReportDialog, and the official push microfrontend instead of PushNotificationsDialog.
- Migration of the Companies page to React — wiring of the route/bundle, table with server-side pagination, and search bar with debounce, moving away from EJS/jQuery.

Sprint Constraints
June 4th will be a holiday in Brazil.

Risks
No risks foreseen in this sprint.

Validations
No stakeholder validation occurred during sprint 2.

Objective – Sprint Goal
Continue building the Torre de Controle (Control Tower) for Middle Mile: add the KPI header so operation health is visible at a glance (trips, in-route, delayed, Act Now, SLA, cost/km), formalize how operators resolve alerts with structured, auditable reasons, and roll out the finalized UI layout across the Control Tower's core screens. The real-time Act Now alerts panel carried over from Sprint 5 is now blocked and needs to be unblocked to avoid slipping a second sprint.

Product and UX/UI

FE layout updates on the Control Tower Main Page (OE-239), Act Now (OE-240) and Trip Detail (OE-241), per finalized Figma — To Do
Evaluation: unify the basic-company "comment" modal with the incidences modal (OE-247) — In Progress

Main Deliveries

Control Tower KPI header — Backend (OE-273) and Frontend (OE-232) — To Do
Act Now — structured tratativa (resolution) reasons, operator↔driver (OE-220) + backend persistence (OE-279) — To Do

Progress (carried over from Sprint 5)

Persist/display destination ETA via price_detail, owned by INF (OE-203) — In Progress
Act Now panel — real-time alert updates via session channels (OE-202) — Blocked ⚠️

Must Be Completed This Sprint

Unblock and ship the Act Now real-time alerts panel (OE-202)
ETA persistence via price_detail (OE-203)
KPI header, backend + frontend (OE-273, OE-232)

Also In This Sprint (maintenance / tech debt)
Reserved-points tech support (OE-290) and Import Edit Address UX (OE-197) — To Do. Vehicle assignment duplicate-plate filter fix (OE-191) — Code Review. RCD-TECHLOG order date issue (OE-93) — Rejected by QA, needs rework. Monthly planning & retrospective ceremony (OE-250).

Sprint Goal
Reduce operational risk and improve visibility of Slots

Main deliveries
- Re-enable Save Filters and fix filter persistence and presentation.
- Implement a notification panel for slots without assigned drivers.
- Improvements in Slot Detail: show Slot ID / Coverage ID / Shift ID, fix map fitBounds, and add a legend for driver color states.
- Operational rules and validations: block creation of slots for past shifts, prohibit Zipcode Ranges with slotsEnabled = true, and apply restrictions on edit/move/delete based on slot state and proximity to shift start.

We need to be available for any support team tickets, QA cards, and cards that may come from other squads during this transition period.

customfield_10020.name: EE Sprint 6
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal:

Balance the squad's strategic pillars — IDwall, Fleet, Gamification, and TOTVS/Integration — keeping the sprint lean and allowing continuous refinement on the areas of highest current focus: Fleet and IDwall.

Main Deliveries
IDwall — EE-235 (4 pts): Registration failure caused by CPF length validation — bug fix that may be artificially inflating the error rate in the registration flow.
Fleet — EE-254 (8 pts): Phone number format validation for driver registration. EE-231 (8 pts): Fix phone number update flow in the app, prerequisite for the upcoming communication campaign. EE-238 (9 pts): Review and understanding, preparation for driver migration.
Gamification — EE-186 (5 pts): Review and fix Gamification UI (carried over from Sprint 5).
TOTVS/Integration — EE-237 (7 pts): ADR formalizing the request → ADR → prioritization → sprint flow.
Tech Support — EE-247, EE-248, EE-253 (7–13 pts each): consolidated low-effort support containers.

Sprint Constraints
Feriado Ecuador: segunda-feira, 10/08 é feriado nacional (Primer Grito de Independencia) — reduz a capacidade de José Cedeño na segunda semana da sprint (a sprint roda de 28/07 a 11/08).
Nenhum feriado em São Paulo durante o período da sprint.

Risks
Investigação de CPF (EE-235) pode revelar impacto maior do que o estimado nas validações de cadastro do IDwall.
Validations
Sprint validations conducted by the Communities, Operations, and Finance teams.

customfield_10020.name: Sprint 1
customfield_10020.goal:
Sprint Goal
Reduce operational risk and improve visibility of Slots

Main deliveries
- Re-enable Save Filters and fix filter persistence and presentation.
- Implement a notification panel for slots without assigned drivers.
- Improvements in Slot Detail: show Slot ID / Coverage ID / Shift ID, fix map fitBounds, and add a legend for driver color states.
- Operational rules and validations: block creation of slots for past shifts, prohibit Zipcode Ranges with slotsEnabled = true, and apply restrictions on edit/move/delete based on slot state and proximity to shift start.

Technical support:
We need to be available for any support team tickets, QA cards, and cards that may come from other squads during this transition period.

Sprint Constraints
May 25th is a holiday for the team that is outside of Brazil. 

Risks
No identified risks related to the Slots project. Monitor for possible intrusions from Middle Mile / Control Tower topics.

Validations
Validate the final delivery with Naiara Domingues and the Operations team, and monitor for potential improvements after release.
